sentences.text: Rhegminornis calobates was an extinct turkey that lived in Florida during the early Miocene. It is the only known species in its genus.
This bird belongs to the class Aves, the order Galliformes, the family Phasianidae, and the subfamily Meleagridinae.
Alexander Wetmore formally described this species in 1943.
Fossils come from the Early Miocene Alachua Formation at the Thomas Farm site. The genus lived between 18.5 and 16.3 million years ago during the Burdigalian age.
